name: explicit_criticism
definition: A historical source actor explicitly marks a proposition/actor as mistaken, doubtful, false, or otherwise defective.

name: explicit_endorsement
definition: A historical source actor explicitly marks a proposition/actor as correct, sound, confirmed, or equivalent positive stance.

name: explicit_correction_of_prior_critic
definition: A historical source actor explicitly states that a prior criticism/error attribution is itself mistaken.
allowed_basis: verbatim wording naming or clearly targeting prior critic/criticism

name: explicit_uncertainty
definition: A historical source actor explicitly marks uncertainty, possibility, conjecture, or doubt.

name: explicit_scope_shift
definition: A historical source actor explicitly moves from a base report to a broader interpretive/historical projection.
allowed_basis: verbatim editorial wording showing the broader projected claim
